outcome.reason: Customer did not provide a specific date or amount for payment and declined a callback.

transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh Sharma speaking. How can I help you?

Thank you, Mr. Sharma. I’m calling regarding your Mumbai Bank credit card. According to our records, the minimum amount due of Rs 4,820 was due on 2026-10-15 and has not been received yet.

Could you please let me know if you have already made this payment, or when you plan to make it?
I haven’t made the payment yet, but I’ll pay soon. Please don’t worry about it.

Thank you for letting me know. Could you please specify an exact date within the next 14 days when you plan to make at least the minimum payment of Rs 4,820? This will help us update our records accurately.
I can’t give you an exact date right now, but I promise I’ll take care of it in a few days.

I understand, Mr. Sharma. For our records, we do need a specific date and amount to note a payment commitment. Since you’re not able to provide this right now, would you like me to arrange a callback at a more convenient time for you? If yes, please let me know your preferred time for a callback.
No need for a callback. I’ll pay soon, just give me a little more time.
